title: Build the iPhone Shortcuts: capture, retry, photo, and the daily prompts

intro.verdict_html: A Shortcut file cannot be made or signed on a Windows PC, so each one is built once on the phone from these steps. After that its iCloud link is the backup. Nothing is lost if a step goes wrong: the recording stays in iCloud Drive until the server says saved.
prerequisites: iPhone on iOS 26 or later, Shortcuts app installed
Signed in to Mycelium on the PC (to make the token)
Ten quiet minutes for the first Shortcut; the others are copies of its pattern
time: Photo, share and quick note: 10 minutes

phases.title: Before you start
phases.lede_html: One token for the phone, one folder for recordings.

steps.title: Make the phone's token
steps.body_html: Name it iPhone Shortcuts. In the for box choose iPhone Shortcuts (capture and the daily prompts). Leave write ticked. Press Create and copy the value: it is shown once.

notes.html: This token can send captures and ask for the daily prompts. It cannot read tickets, review captures, or open settings, so a phone that is lost gives away nothing but the ability to add captures. Revoke it from the same page.
The old Shortcuts used the app's master secret. Once these are working, that secret gets rotated (a separate item in your queue) and the old Shortcuts stop working, which is the point.

steps.title: Get the token onto the phone
steps.body_html: Paste it into a note in Apple Notes on the PC (icloud.com) or send it to yourself in a way you trust, and copy it on the phone. You paste it into each Shortcut once. Delete the note afterwards.

steps.title: Create the recordings folder
steps.body_html: In the Files app open iCloud Drive, then the Shortcuts folder, and make a new folder called exactly Mycelium Inbox.

notes.html: The folder must exist before the Shortcut runs. Saving without a prompt only works inside iCloud Drive/Shortcuts, and the save fails if the sub-folder is missing.

phases.title: The capture Shortcut
phases.lede_html: Speak, see your words, fix them if you want, done. The recording and the words both go up; the words go first, before the edit box, so closing the box loses nothing.
phases.why_html: Dictate Text keeps no audio and Record Audio makes no text, so the Shortcut records first and transcribes the recording. The server keeps the recording too and re-transcribes it on the PC, which is why a poor on-phone transcript is not a problem.

steps.title: New Shortcut, named Capture
steps.body_html: Create a new Shortcut and name it Capture. Add the actions below in order. Search for each by the name in bold.

steps.title: Make an id for this capture
steps.body_html:
1. Date: Current Date.
  2. Format Date: Date Format Custom, Format String as below.
  3. Random Number: between 1000 and 9999.
  4. Text: type sc-, insert Formatted Date, type -, insert Random Number.
  5. Set Variable: name it id.

notes.html: The id travels with the words and with the recording. It is how the server knows a re-send is the same capture and not a second one.

steps.title: Record, and keep the recording
steps.body_html:
1. Record Audio: Audio Quality Normal, Start Recording Immediately, Finish Recording On Tap.
  2. Set Name: Name = the id variable (tap the field, choose Select Variable).
  3. Save File: turn Ask Where to Save off; Destination Path as below. Turn Overwrite If File Exists on.
  4. Set Variable: name it file (it holds the saved file).

notes.html: Normal, not Very High. Very High records uncompressed audio and a two-minute note becomes too large to send in one piece.

steps.title: Turn the recording into words
steps.body_html:
1. Transcribe Audio: input is the file variable.
  2. Set Variable: name it words.

notes.html: If this comes back empty or wrong, carry on. The edit box in step 1.6 still opens, and the PC transcribes the recording anyway.

steps.title: Send the words at once
steps.body_html:
1. If: words has any value.
  2. Inside the If: Get Contents of URL. URL as below. Tap Show More: Method POST. Headers: add Authorization with the value below. Request Body JSON, with these four fields:
    • text (Text) = words
    • client_uuid (Text) = id
    • source (Text) = shortcut
    • await_edit (Boolean) = true
  3. End If.

blocks.label: Authorization header value
blocks.text: Bearer mtk_… (the word Bearer, one space, then your token)

notes.html: Type the word Bearer, a space, then paste the token. The token is never typed into this checklist: answers here are stored with the ticket, and a token does not belong there.

steps.title: The edit box
steps.body_html:
1. Ask for Input: Input Type Text, Prompt Fix anything, then Done. Tap Show More: Default Answer = words, and turn Allow Multiple Lines on.
  2. Set Variable: name it final.

notes.html: If you swipe the box away the Shortcut stops here. That is fine: the unedited words went up in step 1.5 and the capture is filed from them.

steps.title: Send the answer to the edit box
steps.body_html:
1. If: final is words.
  2. Inside: Get Contents of URL, same URL, POST, same Authorization header, JSON: text = words, client_uuid = id, source = shortcut, final (Boolean) = true.
  3. Otherwise: the same action again, but text = final, and one more field edited (Boolean) = true.
  4. End If.

notes.html: Build the first Get Contents of URL, then long-press it and Duplicate for the second: only the text field changes and one field is added.

steps.title: Send the recording, and delete it only when the server has it
steps.body_html:
1. Get Contents of URL: URL as below, POST, same Authorization header, Request Body Form, with two fields: audio (File) = file, and client_uuid (Text) = id.
  2. Get Dictionary Value: Get Value for status in Contents of URL.
  3. If: Dictionary Value is saved.
  4. Inside: Delete Files: file, with Confirm Before Deleting off.
  5. Otherwise: Show Notification: Kept on the phone. Run Retry later.
  6. End If.

notes.html: A Shortcut cannot see whether a request succeeded, only what came back. That is why it reads status and deletes on the word saved and nothing else. No signal, an error page, anything unexpected: the file stays.

steps.title: Let it run from the lock screen
steps.body_html: Tap the Shortcut's name at the top, then the i: under Privacy turn on Allow Running When Locked. Run the Shortcut once from the app and allow each permission it asks for (microphone, speech recognition, iCloud Drive, the website) with Always Allow.

verify_html: Run it and say: Remind me tomorrow at nine to ring the plumber. The box shows your words. Press Done.
Within a few seconds a notification says what it was filed as.
Files → iCloud Drive → Shortcuts → Mycelium Inbox is empty again.

phases.title: The Retry Shortcut
phases.lede_html: Sends anything still sitting in the Mycelium Inbox folder. Safe to run any number of times.

steps.title: New Shortcut, named Capture retry
steps.body_html:
1. Get Contents of Folder: Folder = Shortcuts/Mycelium Inbox.
  2. Repeat with Each item in Contents of Folder.
  3. Inside: Get Details of Files: Get Name from Repeat Item.
  4. Get Contents of URL: the capture-audio URL, POST, the Authorization header, Form: audio (File) = Repeat Item, client_uuid (Text) = Name.
  5. Get Dictionary Value: status.
  6. If it is saved: Delete Files: Repeat Item, Confirm Before Deleting off. End If.
  7. End Repeat.

blocks.label: Authorization header value
blocks.text: Bearer mtk_… (the word Bearer, one space, then your token)

notes.html: The file's name is the capture's id, so a recording whose words already arrived joins them, and one that never sent anything becomes a capture from the recording alone: the PC writes the words.

steps.title: It runs by itself when the phone goes on charge
steps.body_html: Nothing to build here: step 5.2 makes one automation for Charger → Is Connected, and its first action is Run Shortcut → Capture retry. So anything a bad signal left behind goes up the next time the phone is plugged in.

steps.title: Action Button
steps.body_html: Swipe to Shortcut and choose Capture. iPhone 15 Pro or later; skip if yours has no Action Button.

steps.title: Lock screen and Home Screen
steps.body_html: Lock screen: long-press → Customise → Lock Screen → replace one of the two bottom controls with Shortcut → Capture. Home Screen: in Shortcuts, long-press Capture → Add to Home Screen.

steps.title: By voice
steps.body_html: Nothing to set up: say Hey Siri, Capture. The Shortcut's name is the phrase.

phases.title: Photo, share sheet and quick note
phases.lede_html: A photo or screenshot; a link or a piece of text from any app; a note typed without opening the app.

steps.title: New Shortcut, named Capture photo
steps.body_html:
Tap the i: turn on Show in Share Sheet; Share Sheet Types: Images only. Under "If there's no input" choose Take Photo. Then the actions:
  1. The id, exactly as step 1.2 (duplicate those five actions; start the text with ph-).
  2. Convert Image: Shortcut Input to JPEG, Quality about 80%.
  3. Ask for Input: Text, Prompt Anything to add? (leave empty and press Done to skip).
  4. Get Contents of URL: URL as below, POST, the Authorization header, Form: image (File) = Converted Image, client_uuid (Text) = id, text (Text) = Provided Input.
  5. Get Dictionary Value: status. If it is not saved: Show Notification: Not saved. Share it again.

blocks.label: Authorization header value
blocks.text: Bearer mtk_… (the word Bearer, one space, then your token)

notes.html: No model reads the picture (that costs money). With words, the words are filed like any capture and the photo rides along; without, it waits in review as a photo and you say what it is.

steps.title: New Shortcut, named Capture this (links and text from any app)
steps.body_html:
Tap the i: turn on Show in Share Sheet; Share Sheet Types: Text, URLs and Safari web pages only. Then:
  1. The id, as step 1.2 (start the text with sh-).
  2. Ask for Input: Text, Prompt Anything to add? (Done with nothing typed skips it).
  3. Text: insert Provided Input, a new line, then Shortcut Input.
  4. Get Contents of URL: the capture URL from step 1.5, POST, the Authorization header, JSON: text = that Text, client_uuid = id, source = shortcut.
  5. Get Dictionary Value: status. If it is not saved: Show Notification: Not saved. Share it again.

notes.html: A link is kept as the link with your words above it. It goes to review like any capture; a web page is not fetched or summarised (that would cost money).

steps.title: New Shortcut, named Quick note (typed, from the Home Screen)
steps.body_html:
1. The id, as step 1.2 (start the text with qn-).
  2. Ask for Input: Text, Prompt Note, Allow Multiple Lines on.
  3. Get Contents of URL: the capture URL, POST, the Authorization header, JSON: text = Provided Input, client_uuid = id, source = shortcut.
  4. Get Dictionary Value: status. If it is not saved: Copy to Clipboard: Provided Input, then Show Notification: Not saved. Your note is on the clipboard.
Then long-press the Shortcut → Add to Home Screen, or add it as a small Shortcuts widget.

phases.title: The daily prompts
phases.lede_html: Three automations. Each one calls the server and shows or speaks the single line that comes back.

steps.title: Morning: when the alarm is stopped
steps.body_html:
New automation: Alarm → Is Stopped → Wake-Up (or Any) → Run Immediately. Actions:
  1. Get Contents of URL: URL as below, POST, the Authorization header, no body.
  2. Get Dictionary Value: say.
  3. Show Notification: Dictionary Value. (Or Speak Text if you would rather hear it.)
  4. Open URL: https://mycelium.sporebit.com/today (optional).

blocks.label: Authorization header value
blocks.text: Bearer mtk_… (the word Bearer, one space, then your token)

notes.html: The server prepares today's proposal once and answers with one line: the one thing, its first step, about how long. If you do nothing for 45 minutes the proposal becomes the plan. Stopping the alarm twice changes nothing.

steps.title: Plugging in: send what was left, and offer the evening close
steps.body_html:
New automation: Charger → Is Connected → Run Immediately, Notify When Run off. Actions:
  1. Run Shortcut: Capture retry.
  2. Date: Current Date. Format Date: Custom, HH.
  3. If Formatted Date is greater than or equal to 20.
  4. Inside: Get Contents of URL: URL as below, POST, the Authorization header, Request Body JSON: action (Text) = prompt.
  5. End If.

notes.html: The server sends the evening prompt itself, once a day, so plugging in twice does nothing the second time. If the phone is never plugged in, the prompt still goes at the fallback time (21:30 unless you change it in Settings).

steps.title: The pause before a scroll app (optional)
steps.body_html:
One automation per app you want a pause on: App → choose the app → Is Opened → Run Immediately. Actions:
  1. Get Contents of URL: URL as below, method GET, the Authorization header.
  2. Get Dictionary Value: say.
  3. Choose from Menu: Prompt = Dictionary Value; two items: Close app and Continue.
  4. Under Close app: Go to Home Screen. Under Continue: nothing.

notes.html: Not verified in writing: whether the automation fires again when the app comes back to the front after Continue. If it nags, delete it; the rest does not depend on it.
It shows only what is next: the thing, its first step, about how long. No count of what is undone, no lecture.

steps.title: A long one
steps.body_html: Run Capture and talk for a minute about three different things (something to buy, something to do, an idea). Press Done without editing. The notification should say it was saved as separate items, and tonight's review shows them as ideas with a suggestion each.

fields.label: What happened
fields.placeholder: e.g. 3 items, all right / one wrong: …

steps.title: An edited one
steps.body_html: Run Capture, say something, change a word in the box, Done. In Review the card shows your corrected words, not what was first heard, and it has a Play the recording link.

steps.title: No signal
steps.body_html: Aeroplane mode on. Run Capture, speak, Done. You get Kept on the phone. Aeroplane mode off, run Capture retry: the folder empties and the capture appears in Review a little later with words the PC wrote (the PC must be on; otherwise it waits).

steps.title: Keep the links
steps.body_html: For each Shortcut: Share → Copy iCloud Link, and paste the links here. They are how the Shortcuts come back after a new phone. Before sharing, open each Get Contents of URL and check the token is not in a link you would give anyone else.

fields.label: iCloud links
fields.placeholder: Capture, Capture retry, Capture photo, Capture this, Quick note

notes.html: An iCloud link to a Shortcut contains everything typed into it, including the token. Keep the links to yourself; revoke the token if one gets out.

troubleshooting.symptom: Every send says Kept on the phone
troubleshooting.cause: The Authorization header is wrong: a missing space after Bearer, or the token was cut short when pasted.
troubleshooting.fix: Open the Get Contents of URL action, retype Bearer, one space, paste the token again.

troubleshooting.cause: The Mycelium Inbox folder does not exist inside iCloud Drive/Shortcuts, or Ask Where to Save is still on.
troubleshooting.fix: Create the folder (step 0.3); switch Ask Where to Save off.

troubleshooting.symptom: Transcribe Audio errors or gives one line of a long recording
troubleshooting.fix: Carry on: type in the box if you want, or just press Done. The PC transcribes the recording and replaces poor words unless you edited them by hand.

troubleshooting.cause: The id was not sent, or two different ids were made.
troubleshooting.fix: Check client_uuid is the id variable in every Get Contents of URL, and that the id is made once at the top.

troubleshooting.symptom: The Shortcut stops when the phone is locked
troubleshooting.cause: Record Audio brings Shortcuts to the front and wants the phone unlocked.
troubleshooting.fix: Unlock with Face ID as it starts; Allow Running When Locked covers the rest.

troubleshooting.symptom: A long recording does not upload
troubleshooting.cause: A single upload over about 4 MB is refused by the host (roughly eight minutes at Normal quality).
troubleshooting.fix: Keep one capture under five minutes for now. The file stays in the folder; a larger-upload path is on the build list.
